So, of course, we tried to kill him.|[[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Republic 60">[[Republic 60|''Republic'' 60]]</ref>}}
'''Ky Narec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and trained [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] before being shot in the back by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] raider and killed. His death paved the way for Ventress's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and her becoming [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].

==Biography==
===Training Ventress===
{{Quote|You are strong with the Force, little one.|Ky Narec|<ref name="Nightsisters (episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:Asajjmasterdeath.jpg|thumb|170x170px|Ky's death.]]
Narec's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crashed on the barbaric [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] approximately a decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. There, Narec was immediately attacked by the locals. He fought the raiders and then found a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] girl named [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and after watching her [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]] a raider away, found her to be strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and taught her the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arts.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

Years later, as Ventress grew older, she and Narec fought against the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Osika Kirske/Legends|Osika Kirske]] and eventually became heroes of Rattatak. However, before Narec had the chance to finish Ventress' [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], he was shot in the back by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] raider,<ref name=":0" /> hired by Kirske. Kirske had formed a temporary truce with the other warlords of Rattatak in a unanimous attempt to eliminate both Ventress and Ky Narec.

===Legacy===
Enraged by Narec's death, Ventress turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and later joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to fight the Jedi, whom she thought of as having abandoned Narec, at the behest of [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].

In memory of her former master, Asajj [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] her hairless head with twelve marks, one for each of the twelve warlords she had killed after swearing their deaths.

Narec's lightsaber was kept in [[Castle Ventress|Ventress' palace]], to remind her of him, along with a statue of the man Ventress had comissioned. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used it in conjunction with his own to battle against Ventress. Ventress was very angry that her enemy was using her master's lightsaber. As Kenobi fled Rattatak with [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], he told Asajj that fighting would not bring her master back.

Sometime after these events, when Dooku's assassination attempt on her failed, Ventress fled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where she received treatment from [[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] and her clan of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. During this treatment, Ventress had memory flashbacks of how she had met Narec, her training with him, and ultimately his death. Later, Ventress, [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]], and [[Karis/Legends|Karis]] attacked Count Dooku and nearly killed him, but he proved too powerful and he used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and forced them all to the cliff below. They all survived. The reason for this attack was to get Ventress the revenge she longed for.<ref name=":0" />
